findings.description: The threshold comparison is reversed, returning the maximum wait before the exponential result reaches the cap.
findings.rationale: With multiplier=1, max=60, exp_base=2 and attempt_number=1, the condition evaluates as 0 < log₂(60), so the method returns 60 instead of 1. Ordinary early retries therefore wait the maximum duration; the shortcut should apply when the exponent reaches or exceeds the threshold.

findings.description: The new logarithm can raise ValueError when the positive ratio underflows to zero.
findings.rationale: With multiplier=1e308, max=1e-308 and exp_base=2, max / multiplier rounds to zero, so math.log raises ValueError outside the try block. A retry that previously returned the capped wait now fails instead.
